laws.rule: Torres del Paine: buy entry at least 24 hours before arriving through CONAF's pasesparques.cl. Foreign visitors: day pass CLP 32,400 (18 and over), CLP 16,600 (13 to 17); pass for 2 or more days (up to 10 continuous days) CLP 48,500; under 12 free. (No RBA rate for CLP; at the Servicio de Impuestos Internos de Chile rate of 27 October 2026 crossed via the RBA USD rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 699.9802 CLP: CLP 32,400 ≈ A$46.29; CLP 16,600 ≈ A$23.71; CLP 48,500 ≈ A$69.29)
laws.heading: Tarifas y horarios 2026

laws.rule: Hiking the W trail or the Paine Massif circuit requires confirmed bookings at the park's refuges and campsites (Las Torres Patagonia, Vértice Patagonia); without them you cannot enter the mountain area. Day hikes such as Base Torres and the roadside campsites (Serrano, Pehoé) are exempt.
laws.heading: Sistemas de reservas

laws.rule: Base Torres trail: enter by 9.30 am, leave by 3 pm. Park hours 8 am to 7 pm.
Marked landmine fields remain in parts of Magallanes, between Punta Arenas and Torres del Paine National Park and in Tierra del Fuego. Obey all warning signs and stay on clearly identified roads.
